components.name: FormFieldRow
components.description:
Renders a single FormField (any kind: scalar / nested / repeated).
`pathPrefix` is the dot-separated parent path; `field.requestField` is appended
to build the leaf name attribute (e.g. `groups[0].label`).

components.name: NestedFormFields
components.description: Renders a NestedForm's fields inside a nested container (recursive).

components.name: PanelRenderer
RepeatedFieldControl
components.description:
Stateful repeated-field widget: ordered list of rows with Add / Remove /
Move-up / Move-down controls. Controls are hidden in read-only mode
(mode !== EDIT). Enforces min_items / max_items.

Serialization: each row's inputs carry bracket-indexed names
(`namePath[i]` for scalar, `namePath[i].subField` for nested). A
`<input type="hidden">` at the end of the list carries the JSON-encoded
current row count so a FormData collector can detect empty arrays.

components.name: ViewRenderer
components.description:
Renders a ViewDescriptor. The layout mode selects the arrangement of slots.
`initialData` (optional) is a server-computed page-0 seed keyed by each table
populate's `${service}.${method}`; when present, usePagedRows renders those rows
on the first paint (SSR) and skips the initial client refetch on hydration.

contracts.name: ActionBarProps
contracts.description: Props for a kit's action bar: the actions to render + transport to fire them.

contracts.name: MeridianContextValue
MeridianProviderProps
ShapeProps
contracts.description: Props every shape component receives: its panel, the parent descriptor, transport.

hooks.name: useGrammarResolver
hooks.description:
The host's GrammarPanel transcoder (or undefined). GrammarContent tries it,
then degrades.

hooks.name: useHrefResolver
hooks.description:
The host's table-cell link resolver (or undefined). A link column renders
plain text when absent.

hooks.name: useIcon
hooks.description:
Resolve an `icon` key to a host glyph (or null). Components render the result
before a label; they should ALSO set `data-icon={key}` so the key survives
even when no resolver is wired. Safe to call with an empty/absent key.

hooks.name: usePagedRows
hooks.description:
Fetch + page a TablePanel's rows through the invoker. CLIENT returns all rows
(the kit's table paginates locally); OFFSET / CURSOR fetch one page at a time.
hooks.signature: function usePagedRows(panel: TablePanel, invoker: RpcInvoker): PagedTable;

hooks.name: useRecord
hooks.description:
Fetch the single record a detail panel binds to. The counterpart of
`usePagedRows` for a one-record view: it invokes `populate` once with the
request field named by `idField` (default "id") set to `subjectId`
(ViewDescriptor.subject_id), and — like the table — consumes an SSR seed from
`MeridianInitialDataContext` (a record is stored as a one-row page, so the seed
key is `${service}.${method}` and the record is `seed.rows[0]`) so the server
paint carries real values and the client hydrates without an immediate refetch.
No `populate` ⇒ inert (undefined record, not loading).
hooks.signature: function useRecord(populate: RpcCall | undefined, idField: string, subjectId: string | undefined, invoker: RpcInvoker): RecordState;

slots.name: id
slots.description: Stable id, e.g. "mui" / "shadcn" / "html". Used in the renderer id.

slots.name: themeToStyle
slots.description:
Bind a meridian.theme.v1.Theme to this kit's style primitive (MUI theme,
CSS custom properties, Tailwind config, …). Returned style is applied to the
panel container. Optional — a kit may bind the theme its own way.

slots.name: Chrome
slots.description: Optional wrapper around every panel (title bar, surface, padding).

slots.name: Form
slots.description: Entity "detail section" / CRUD form (FormPanel: READONLY | EDIT).

slots.name: DetailHeader
slots.description:
Detail-view header — a record's title + optional subtitle/status + descriptor
rows, fetched via the panel's `populate`. PanelRenderer falls back when omitted.

slots.name: RecordCard
slots.description:
Read-only key/value record card (the detail "section"). PanelRenderer falls
back when a kit omits it.

slots.name: Gallery
slots.description: Optional richer shapes; PanelRenderer falls back when a kit omits them.

slots.name: Choice
slots.description:
Optional content shapes (choice / snippet / action / connect-flow /
copy-value / catalog). Static, brand-neutral surfaces; PanelRenderer falls
back when a kit omits them.

slots.name: Grammar
slots.description:
GrammarPanel (markdown / mermaid / plantuml / graphviz / vega). Specialized:
the rich render is host-wired via renderGrammar; the kit degrades to native
markdown / alt / source. PanelRenderer falls back when a kit omits it.

slots.name: Stat
slots.description: KPI tile — a labeled number with a COMPUTED delta/trend + sparkline.

slots.name: Steps
slots.description:
Ordered walkthrough — steps a reader performs, each with an optional
narration, frame and actor. The step NUMBER comes from POSITION; Step
carries no ordinal, so a kit must never render an authored one.

slots.name: Media
slots.description:
Video / audio / image with a poster, captions and chapters. Specialized:
a moving picture is not displayable as text, so a kit that cannot play it
degrades to the poster, then to `alt`. PanelRenderer falls back when a kit
omits it entirely.

slots.name: Fallback
slots.description: Rendered for unknown / unset / unsupported shapes.

slots.name: ActionBar
slots.description:
Renders a view/slot's actions (ViewDescriptor.actions / Slot.actions).
Optional — ViewRenderer falls back to plain buttons when a kit omits it.
